assertions.source: Convention-D Wenzl JM (0.1470) ≠ Plancherel (0.0004) at proton pin: per-block weight difference (historical convention-C grouped values were 0.5952 vs 0.4241).

description: Reconcile binding-trace conventions under canonical Convention D (z_D = q^3/(q^2+1), Wenzl N=2 two-row cap) at the 50-digit proton pin: binding_canonical's Δtr(²H) (0.147047) matches the Wenzl-bridge on the joint H₆ word to all 50 digits, whereas normalized-Plancherel gives 0.000444 (a y_λ weight-scheme difference, not a framework inconsistency; historical convention-C grouped values were 0.5952 vs 0.4241).
